subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘JSEV’ is written as ‘MUHX’, and ‘AFRQ’ is written as ‘DHUS’. How will ‘ZTHN’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position and positional value of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

For, ‘JSEV’ is written as ‘MUHX’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83033eb29cabf1f6a4ac838bd275632badab4bf5839c72f12d9c9d03c795a8e6.png] 

For, ‘AFRQ’ is written as ‘DHUS’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/937e1efe969d85d11b09a40a03726fcf60f7f0fdf05b116cce6c4e27381e6b72.png] 

Similarly, for 'ZTHN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9f4611671fa0d79223f4e710c74000b2d69de8ffd41df35dabfe2c4b710e28b.png] 

So, **'ZTHN'** will be written as **'CVKP'.**

Hence, the correct answer is** *'Option 3'.***
